name: printbridge-monorepo
description: PrintBridge — open-source local print bridge for web apps (QZ Tray alternative, no certificates).

scripts.dist:win: npm run sync:client && npm --workspace apps/desktop run dist:win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run sync:client && npm --workspace apps/desktop run dist:linux
scripts.dist:mac: npm run sync:client && npm --workspace apps/desktop run dist:mac
